title: Zephyrine and the Room
author: Juniper Almeida
blurb: Quentin Marchetti, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
